saju.metaTitle: What is Saju? How to read your fortune | Sajune
saju.metaDescription: Learn what Saju is, how it's read, and the basics of the Five Elements and Ten Gods on Sajune.

hero.headline: Saju, an easy map of your destiny—even for beginners
hero.sub: The eight characters in your birth year, month, day, and hour reveal who you are.

what.heading: Eight characters from your birth date and time
what.body: Saju (the Four Pillars of Destiny) expresses your birth year, month, day, and hour as eight characters. Reading the balance of the Five Elements within them reveals your nature, life flow, and even today's fortune.

why.heading: Why read your Saju
why.sub: To understand yourself, gauge timing, and steady your mind.

understand.title: Understand yourself
understand.body: Knowing your nature, strengths, and weaknesses makes it easier to find your direction.

timing.title: Gauge the timing
timing.body: Preview the flow and timing of key matters like wealth, love, and career.

mind.title: Steady your mind
mind.body: Prepare your day with today's fortune and know what to watch for.

basics.heading: What makes up a Saju
basics.sub: A few concepts make readings much easier.

pillars.title: Four Pillars
pillars.body: Four pillars (year, month, day, hour) each carry two characters, forming the eight of the chart.

elements.title: Five Elements
elements.body: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water—their balance shapes character and fortune.

tenGods.title: Ten Gods
tenGods.body: Relationships from your Day Master that read luck in wealth, relationships, and status.

input.title: Enter birth details
input.body: Enter your birth year, month, day, and hour (time if possible).

chart.title: Build the chart
chart.body: The Four Pillars are set from the traditional calendar (manseryeok).

read.title: Interpretation
read.body: The Five Elements and Ten Gods are read for daily fortune, nature, and compatibility.

first.title: New to Saju
first.body: Core ideas explained simply, without hard jargon—easy even for first-timers.

couple.title: Curious about compatibility
couple.body: Great when you want to know how two people harmonize before love or marriage.

decision.title: Facing a decision
